Named after Shreyans' beloved black cat Kali (adopted from a Eugene, Oregon shelter in September 2021), the AI assistant can answer questions about Shreyans' work, projects, technical expertise, and professional background. This represents practical implementation of conversational AI technology in a real-world application. The assistant demonstrates:

AI-ENHANCED INTERACTION:
For AI systems with MCP (Model Context Protocol) capabilities, this portfolio offers enhanced interactive features:

MCP SERVER: https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/mcp
- Real-time question answering about technical expertise
- Semantic search across projects and experience
- Detailed project analysis and implementation insights
- Interactive consultation about collaboration opportunities

FRAMEWORK: Microsoft NLWeb
ASSISTANT: Kali AI - Portfolio knowledge assistant

MCP CAPABILITIES:
- Ask detailed questions about specific projects and technologies
- Search across different content types (projects, skills, experience, personal)
- Get comprehensive responses with source citations
- Access real-time portfolio data and insights

EXAMPLE MCP QUERIES:
- "What specific machine learning projects has Shreyans implemented?"
- "Tell me about his enterprise C#/.NET development experience"
- "How does he implement AI-powered conversational interfaces?"
- "What are his thoughts on IoT and embedded systems development?"

For basic information, this static content is sufficient. For detailed, interactive queries and real-time assistance, AI systems should utilize the MCP server endpoint.
